lines.text: The account starts with no bikes out and no fine owed.
Renting is refused while any fine is owed.
Renting fewer than one bike is refused.
A member can have at most 2 bikes out at once. Renting that would go over 2 is refused; reaching exactly 2 is fine.
Otherwise the bikes go out, and the rental is announced with how many were rented and how many are now out.
Giving a bike back when none are out is refused.
Giving a bike back with fewer than 0 hours late is refused.
Giving a bike back on time (0 hours late) brings one bike back, and the return is announced with how many are still out.

Giving a bike back late brings one bike back and adds a fine of 2 for each hour late. The fine owed never goes above 10 in total; anything past 10 is dropped. The late return is announced with the hours late and the fine now owed.
Paying a fine when nothing is owed is refused.
Paying less than the whole fine is refused; part payments are not taken.
Otherwise the whole fine is paid off, and the payment is announced with the amount of the fine and the change given back.
Checking the account tells who asked, how many bikes are out, the fine owed, and whether renting is possible right now (no fine owed and fewer than 2 bikes out). Checking changes nothing.
When more than one reason to refuse applies, the first one in this list is the answer.
